en.headline: Housing institute calls for a statutory building upkeep fund
en.dek: The Hong Kong Institute of Housing says owners should pay into a separate maintenance account as more than 24,000 buildings turn 50 by 2043.

zh.headline: 房屋經理學會促設立法定大廈維修基金
zh.dek: 學會指業主應定期向獨立帳戶供款，以應付2043年前逾2.4萬幢樓齡達50年的維修壓力。

en.headline: ICAC charges man, 80, over alleged 10,000 dollar bribe offer
en.dek: Prosecutors say he offered cash to a Yau Tsim Mong councillor to press a pastor into a meeting. He is due in court on Friday.

zh.headline: 廉署起訴八旬翁涉向區議員提供一萬元利益
zh.dek: 控方指他向油尖旺區議員提供現金，意圖促成與一名牧師會面。案件星期五在西九龍裁判法院答辯。

en.headline: Silver Bond due 2027 to pay 4 per cent on fourth coupon
en.dek: The HKMA set the rate at the 4 per cent fixed floor after the inflation-linked floating rate came in at 1.80 per cent.

zh.headline: 2027年到期銀債第四次付息年利率定為4厘
zh.dek: 金管局公布浮息為1.80厘，低於4厘定息，故今次按較高的定息支付，付息日為10月23日。

en.headline: Hang Seng closes 344 points lower at a three-month low
en.dek: The index finished at 23,785 after a second straight fall, with financial and AI-related shares leading the decline.

zh.headline: 恒指收市跌344點 創三個月低位
zh.dek: 指數收報23785點，連跌兩日，金融股及人工智能相關股份領跌。

en.headline: Police arrest 10 over fake model ads used to open mule accounts
en.dek: Officers say a syndicate used job ads to control e-wallet accounts linked to 43 deception cases.

zh.headline: 假模特兒招聘誘開傀儡戶口 警拘10人
zh.dek: 警方指集團以招聘廣告操控電子錢包，涉及43宗騙案。

en.headline: Chan says ride-hailing data system has entered testing
en.dek: The transport chief said the system is largely complete, as nine autonomous-vehicle pilot licences are already issued.

zh.headline: 陳美寶：網約車數據系統已進入測試
zh.dek: 運輸及物流局局長說系統已基本完成，運輸署並已批出九個自動駕駛先導牌照。

en.headline: Motorcyclist dies after Route Twisk collision, police say
en.dek: A 35-year-old rider died after a light goods vehicle left the scene in Pat Heung on Wednesday night.

zh.headline: 荃錦公路電單車司機送院後不治
zh.dek: 八鄉昨晚一輛輕型貨車疑以倒後鏡撞到電單車後駛離，35歲司機延至凌晨不治。

en.headline: AFCD starts four-month sweep for unattended dogs
en.dek: The department said it will first go to places with previous attacks or gatherings of stray dogs.

zh.headline: 漁護署展開四個月捕捉無人看管狗隻行動
zh.dek: 署方說會優先到曾有狗隻襲擊途人，或有流浪狗聚集的地點執法。

en.headline: Police recover gold swapped for fabric softener in Kwun Tong hotel
en.dek: Officers say about 30 kilograms of gold grains, valued at 30 million dollars, were taken from a hotel room and later found in Tai Po.

zh.headline: 觀塘酒店金粒被掉包成柔順劑 警拘兩男起回失金
zh.dek: 警方表示，約30公斤、值約3000萬元的金粒在酒店房間被偷走，其後在大埔賓館起回，兩名持雙程證男子被扣查。

en.headline: Lawmakers press Northern Metropolis university town in LegCo debate
en.dek: On the second day of the joint debate, Andrew Yao called the university town the main course of the Northern Metropolis, while Ng Wing-ka urged infrastructure first.

zh.headline: 立法會辯北都 姚祖輝稱大學城如主菜
zh.dek: 五年規劃與施政報告合併辯論進入北部都會區一節，姚祖輝聚焦大學城，吳永嘉則倡基建先行。

en.headline: National security police bail man and woman over social posts
en.dek: Officers arrested the pair, both 38, in Kwun Tong and Tsim Sha Tsui on Tuesday over an alleged sedition offence, and released them on bail.

zh.headline: 國安處拘一男一女涉社交平台帖文 兩人保釋候查
zh.dek: 警方周二在觀塘及尖沙咀拘捕兩名38歲男女，涉嫌《維護國家安全條例》第24條，兩人已獲准保釋。

en.headline: Victoria Park stall 1 lets for 34,000 dollars, down on last year
en.dek: Now News said the large dry-goods pitch that fetched about 50,000 dollars last year went for 34,000 dollars on the second auction day.

zh.headline: 維園年宵1號乾貨檔以3.4萬元成交 低過去年
zh.dek: Now新聞報道，去年以約5萬元投得的大型乾貨1號檔，周四以3.4萬元由同一人再投得。

en.headline: Police hold woman, 22, over fake official deposit scam
en.dek: Officers say she showed a fake police warrant card and is linked to eight cases, after one victim transferred nearly 650,000 dollars.

zh.headline: 假扮入境處及公安收保證金 22歲女被捕
zh.dek: 西九龍重案組表示，女子涉嫌出示偽造警察委任證，涉及8宗案件，其中一宗事主轉帳近65萬元。

en.headline: Hang Seng slips below 24,000 at the Thursday midday close
en.dek: The index was down 167 points at 23,963 by midday, according to RTHK, with turnover above 100 billion dollars.

zh.headline: 恒指半日失守24000點 跌167點
zh.dek: 港台報道，恒指午市報23963點，跌167點，跌幅約百分之0.7，半日成交逾1000億元。

en.headline: Hong Kong rise three places to 153rd in FIFA ranking
en.dek: The latest men's ranking, published on 7 October, puts Hong Kong on 1,035.23 points after a gain credited to the match against Cambodia.

zh.headline: FIFA排名港隊升3位至第153
zh.dek: 國際足協7日公布最新男足排名，港隊積1035.23分，上升得益於對柬埔寨一仗，港台周四報道有關排名。

en.headline: Reports say police arrest man, 66, over Sau Mau Ping paint attack
en.dek: Hong Kong 01 and Sing Tao, citing sources, say a 66-year-old estate resident was held over red paint thrown at two lawmakers' joint office.

zh.headline: 消息指秀茂坪淋紅油案 警方拘捕66歲男子
zh.dek: 《香港01》及星島引述消息稱，一名66歲邨內居民涉向兩名議員聯合辦事處淋紅油，已被拘捕，案件列刑事毀壞。

en.headline: Mainland arrivals pass golden week forecast in six days
en.dek: Immigration Department figures put mainland visitor arrivals at 1.3 million in the first six days, above the 1.29 million forecast for the full holiday.

zh.headline: 內地訪港六日已超黃金周預測
zh.dek: 入境處數字顯示，國慶假期首六日內地旅客達一百三十萬人次，高於整周一百二十九萬的預測，按年升百分之十一點六。

en.headline: Cross-boundary operator proposes lower Huanggang senior fares
en.dek: Eternal East Bus wants elderly and disabled fares on its Huanggang routes cut toward franchised-bus levels, and hopes to join the two-dollar scheme.

zh.headline: 跨境巴士擬減皇崗長者車費
zh.dek: 永東直巴希望把來往皇崗的長者及殘疾人士車費減至與專營巴士相若，並爭取納入兩元乘車優惠。

en.headline: Trade council's 60th-anniversary show runs at Times Square
en.dek: The Hong Kong Trade Development Council exhibition in Causeway Bay is open daily until 14 October, with a companion artwork at a Wan Chai tram stop.

zh.headline: 貿發局六十周年展覽銅鑼灣展出
zh.dek: 展覽在時代廣場地面有蓋廣場舉行，每日開放至十月十四日；灣仔柯布連道電車站另有主題畫作，展至十月二十九日。

en.headline: David Silva comes out of retirement to join Supreme Sha Tin
en.dek: The former Spain and Manchester City midfielder, 40, is expected in Hong Kong soon for a fitness check before training with the Premier League club.

zh.headline: 施華四十歲復出 加盟港超球會沙田
zh.dek: 前西班牙及曼城中場施華將抵港接受體能評估，再與球隊訓練，沙田下一仗於十月十八日對香港足球會。

en.headline: Police hold helper after report of assault on boy, 5
en.dek: A 37-year-old domestic helper was arrested in Kowloon City after a mother reported that her son had been hit at their Hau Wong Road home.

zh.headline: 九龍城5歲男童疑遭外傭襲擊 37歲菲傭被捕
zh.dek: 一名母親周三晚報案，指5歲兒子在侯王道住所疑被外傭不當對待，警方以涉嫌虐待受看管兒童拘捕37歲菲傭。

en.headline: Anderson's first mall opens in stages before 13 October
en.dek: Link says Link Square in the Anderson Road Quarry development is in soft opening, with a formal launch set for 13 October.

zh.headline: 安達臣首個商場領達廣場分階段啟用 13日正式開幕
zh.dek: 領展表示，觀塘安達臣道石礦場發展區的領達廣場已於10月6日起試業，正式開幕訂於10月13日。

en.headline: Police investigate red-paint attack on Sau Mau Ping offices
en.dek: Officers were called at 6:40am after red paint was thrown at a joint district office used by two lawmakers in Sau Mau Ping Estate.

zh.headline: 秀茂坪議員聯合辦事處遭淋紅油 警列刑事毀壞
zh.dek: 警方今早約6時40分接報，秀茂坪邨秀緻樓地下鄧家彪與陳沛良的聯合地區辦事處被淋紅油，鐵閘及告示板均沾污。

en.headline: SFC sets November start for retail fund code changes
en.dek: The securities watchdog will bring in a value-at-risk method for derivatives exposure and tighter liquidity rules for authorised retail funds.

zh.headline: 證監會零售基金守則修訂十一月生效
zh.dek: 證監會公布諮詢總結，單位信託及互惠基金守則將引入風險價值計算法管理衍生工具風險，並加強流動性及貨幣市場基金保障。

en.headline: Overnight slip-road closures on Central Kowloon Bypass
en.dek: Two Yau Ma Tei slip roads will shut from 12:30am to 5:30am on 8 to 10 October and again on 13 and 14 October.

zh.headline: 中九龍繞道油麻地段支路連夜封閉
zh.dek: 兩條支路於10月8至10日及13至14日凌晨12時30分至上午5時30分禁止車輛駛入。

en.headline: Observatory cancels red fire danger warning
en.dek: The warning, raised at 7:45am on Wednesday, was cancelled at 11:15pm. Thursday is forecast mainly fine and dry.

zh.headline: 天文台取消紅色火災危險警告
zh.dek: 警告於星期三早上7時45分發出，晚上11時15分取消。星期四大致天晴乾燥。

en.headline: Customs and firefighters seize 30,000 litres of illicit fuel
en.dek: A joint operation from 16 to 30 September broke seven cases, with nine people arrested and eight vehicles seized.

zh.headline: 海關消防聯合行動檢約3萬公升非法燃油
zh.dek: 代號「擊破」的行動於9月16日至30日進行，偵破7案，拘捕9人並檢獲8輛車。

en.headline: Police arrest man after knife report at Kowloon Bay market
en.dek: Officers stopped a Route 1A bus near Choi Hung and seized a knife about 32 centimetres long from a 46-year-old man.

zh.headline: 啟業街市持刀報案 警方彩虹截巴士拘捕男子
zh.dek: 人員在太子道東近彩虹邨截停1A巴士，在一名46歲男子的斜孭袋內檢獲約32厘米長刀。

en.headline: WestK picnic series holds its last weekend at Art Park
en.dek: The West Kowloon Cultural District's picnic programme returns from 2pm to 9pm on Friday, Saturday and Sunday, and ends on 11 October.

zh.headline: 西九野餐祭本周末最後一輪在藝術公園舉行
zh.dek: 西九文化區表示，野餐祭星期五至日下午2時至9時在藝術公園海濱東草坪舉行，系列於11日結束。

en.headline: Development Bureau reviewing Queen Mary lift reports
en.dek: The bureau said it had received reports from the electrical and buildings departments and aimed to brief the Chief Executive in mid-October.

zh.headline: 發展局正審視瑪麗醫院升降機調查報告
zh.dek: 局方稱已收到機電工程署及建築署報告，目標10月中向行政長官提交調查報告。

en.headline: Customs seize 450,000 dollars of suspected medicines at border
en.dek: A 37-year-old woman driver was charged with attempting to export unmanifested cargo and was due at West Kowloon Magistrates' Courts on Thursday.

zh.headline: 海關口岸截私家車 檢約45萬元懷疑藥劑製品
zh.dek: 一名37歲女司機被控企圖輸出未列艙單貨物，案件星期四在西九龍裁判法院提堂。

en.headline: Election Committee nomination period opens with 307 forms
en.dek: Returning officers received 305 candidate forms and two designated-body forms on the first day, with nominations open until 20 October.

zh.headline: 選委會提名期首日接獲307份表格
zh.dek: 政府表示，各選舉主任星期三接獲305份候選人提名表格及兩份指定團體提名表格，提名期至10月20日。

en.headline: Lam Tsuen spring fair stalls go to auction on 21 October
en.dek: The Food and Environmental Hygiene Department will offer 21 dry-goods and six wet-goods pitches for the 2027 fair in Tai Po.

zh.headline: 林村放馬莆新春市場攤位10月21日競投
zh.dek: 食環署公布，2027年市場設21個乾貨及6個濕貨攤位，競投底價分別為780元及770元。

en.headline: Watchdog opens consultation on two radio licence renewals
en.dek: The Communications Authority is taking views until 6 December on Commercial Radio and Metro Broadcast, whose licences expire in August 2028.

zh.headline: 通訊局就商台及新城牌照續期展開諮詢
zh.dek: 公眾諮詢由10月7日起至12月6日，兩台聲音廣播牌照於2028年8月25日屆滿。

en.headline: Police arrest woman after boy rescued from Kwun Tong fire
en.dek: Officers said a 42-year-old woman was held on suspicion of child neglect after a blaze at Tsui Ping (North) Estate on Wednesday night.

zh.headline: 翠屏北邨火警後 警方拘捕42歲女子
zh.dek: 警方稱，女子涉嫌對所看管兒童虐待或忽略被捕，正被扣查，案件交觀塘警區刑事調查隊跟進。

en.headline: Golden Fortune and Audacious Pursuit win at Happy Valley
en.dek: The Hong Kong Jockey Club carded a nine-race night meeting on the C+3 course, with the ground rated good to firm.

zh.headline: 跑馬地夜賽金運來及大膽追擊勝出
zh.dek: 馬會周三在跑馬地草地C+3跑道舉行九場夜賽，場地評為好地至快地。

en.headline: Cultural Centre moonlit lanterns stay lit until Sunday
en.dek: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department's Moonlit Bunny Crew installation at the Cultural Centre Piazza runs until 11 October.

zh.headline: 文化中心月下兔燈飾亮至周日
zh.dek: 康文署在香港文化中心廣場的「月下兔仔團」燈飾裝置展至10月11日，每晚六時半至十一時亮燈。

en.headline: Anta completes purchase of 29 per cent stake in Puma
en.dek: The sportswear group said the 1.5 billion euro deal closed on Wednesday, making it Puma's largest shareholder.

zh.headline: 安踏完成收購Puma約29%股權
zh.dek: 集團以15.055億歐元向Pinault家族投資公司購入股份，交割於星期三完成，成為最大股東。

en.headline: Centre warns against French Camembert over bacteria risk
en.dek: A 250-gram Camembert batch imported by Repertoire Culinaire has been taken off sale after an EU alert.

zh.headline: 食安中心籲勿食一批法國軟芝士
zh.dek: Camembert Bertrand Crémier批次232511或受產志賀毒素大腸桿菌污染，進口商已停售並回收。

en.headline: Firefighters rescue boy, 13, from Kwun Tong flat fire
en.dek: A blaze at Tsui Ping (North) Estate sent a boy onto an air-conditioner ledge; he was taken to hospital conscious.

zh.headline: 觀塘翠屏北邨單位起火 13歲男童獲救送院
zh.dek: 翠桃樓晚上近八時火警，男童一度蹲在外牆冷氣機上，清醒後送往聯合醫院，約70人自行疏散。

en.headline: Girl, 11, in intensive care with flu and severe pneumonia
en.dek: The Centre for Health Protection said the child has a chronic illness, tested positive for influenza A H1, and had not had this season's vaccine.

zh.headline: 11歲女童染甲型流感併發嚴重肺炎 情況嚴重
zh.dek: 衞生防護中心稱，該名有長期病患的女童對甲型H1流感呈陽性，未接種本季流感疫苗，現於兒童深切治療部留醫。

en.headline: Police arrest 17 more over suspected crash-for-cash claims
en.dek: Commercial crime officers said the latest round involved 63 claims worth 25 million dollars, taking the year's arrests to 55.

zh.headline: 警方再拘17名懷疑交通意外索償騙徒
zh.dek: 商業罪案調查科稱，最新一輪行動涉63宗索償、金額約2500萬元，今年累計拘捕55人。

en.headline: Police arrest two adults over Tuen Mun child-neglect allegation
en.dek: Officers said a 38-year-old man and a 32-year-old woman were detained after a video showed a girl carrying bags of beer at Fu Tai Estate.

zh.headline: 屯門富泰邨父母涉虐兒被捕 正被扣查
zh.dek: 警方稱，新界北虐兒案件調查組周三下午拘捕一名38歲男子及一名32歲女子，女童沒有表面受傷。

en.headline: Wine and Dine Festival adds later nights and more stalls
en.dek: The Tourism Board said the Central Harbourfront event from 29 October to 1 November expects about 168,000 visitors and will open until 1am on two nights.

zh.headline: 美酒佳餚巡禮增設深夜時段 攤位多一成
zh.dek: 旅發局稱，巡禮10月29日至11月1日於中環海濱舉行，並擴至添馬公園，預計約16.8萬人次到場。

en.headline: Sa Sa says National Day sales in Hong Kong and Macau rose over 60 per cent
en.dek: The retailer also reported second-quarter turnover of 1.41 billion dollars, up more than 37 per cent from a year earlier.

zh.headline: 莎莎：國慶假期港澳線下銷售按年升逾六成
zh.dek: 集團亦公布上季總營業額14.1億元，按年升逾37%，港澳線下業務升52%至11.2億元。

en.headline: Police seize record 31 million dollars of etomidate powder
en.dek: Officers found about 25 kilograms of suspected etomidate in a Lai Chi Kok unit disguised as a logistics office and arrested two men.

zh.headline: 警搗荔枝角工廈毒品倉 檢獲歷來最多依托咪酯
zh.dek: 毒品調查科在荔枝角一個偽裝成物流公司辦公室的單位，檢獲約25公斤懷疑依托咪酯粉末，市值逾3100萬元，兩名男子被捕。

en.headline: Hang Seng Tech Index to expand to 50 stocks in December
en.dek: Hang Seng Indexes Company said each proposal in its consultation drew support from more than 80 per cent of respondents.

zh.headline: 科指成份股增至50隻 12月7日生效
zh.dek: 恒指公司公布諮詢結果，每項建議均獲逾八成回應單位支持，將採納大部分修訂，並於11月20日季檢公布成份股變動。

en.headline: One illegal guide jailed 54 days after undercover booking
en.dek: Immigration officers and the Travel Industry Council posed as customers and arrested two mainland visitors offering guide and photo services.

zh.headline: 入境處放蛇拘兩名非法導遊 一人判囚54日
zh.dek: 入境處聯同旅監局喬裝顧客，拘捕兩名來港提供導遊及攝影服務的內地旅客，其中一人在沙田裁判法院認罪，判囚54日。

en.headline: Lands Department clears nine presale consents for 3,766 flats
en.dek: Eight of the third-quarter consents cover phased projects in Kai Tak, Chai Wan, Cheung Sha Wan, Yau Tong, Tai Po and To Kwa Wan.

zh.headline: 地政總署上季批出9份預售同意書 涉3766伙
zh.dek: 第3季批出的住宅預售樓花同意書涵蓋啟德、柴灣、長沙灣、油塘、大埔及土瓜灣，其中3226伙預計2028年落成。

en.headline: Watchdog issues strong advice over TVB health programme
en.dek: The Communications Authority upheld 10 complaints about claims on a March TVB Plus show and urged the station to follow the programme code.

zh.headline: 通訊局就TVB健康節目發強烈勸諭
zh.dek: 通訊局接獲10宗投訴，指TVB Plus三月播出的節目含可能不準確及有誤導風險的健康建議，裁定投訴成立。

en.headline: Police arrest 89 in three-day anti-triad operation
en.dek: Officers said the operation, codenamed Flowing Shade, ran from Sunday to Tuesday and seized etomidate, methamphetamine and cocaine.

zh.headline: 警方三日反黑行動拘捕89人 檢獲依托咪酯及可卡因
zh.dek: 有組織罪案及三合會調查科稱，代號「逸影」的行動於周日至今早展開，檢獲依托咪酯、冰毒及可卡因。

en.headline: Hang Seng closes 150 points lower, ending a two-day rise
en.dek: The index finished at 24,130, down 0.62 per cent, after touching 24,071. The property sub-index rose 1 per cent.

zh.headline: 恒指收市跌150點 結束連升兩日
zh.dek: 恒指收報24130點，跌0.62%，盤中低見24071點。地產分類指數則升1%。

en.headline: Judges and judicial officers to receive a 2 per cent pay rise
en.dek: The Executive Council accepted the standing committee's advice. The increase is backdated to 1 April and still needs Finance Committee approval.

zh.headline: 法官及司法人員薪酬上調2% 追溯至4月1日
zh.dek: 行政會議接納司法人員薪常會建議，調整追溯至今年4月1日，仍須立法會財委會批准。

en.headline: Yau says misuse of another person's name on SIM cards will be criminalised
en.dek: The commerce secretary told lawmakers the government is also considering a lower cap on prepaid cards a person may register.

zh.headline: 丘應樺：擬將不當用他人名義登記電話卡刑事化
zh.dek: 商務及經濟發展局局長書面回覆立法會，指政府亦正考慮降低個人可登記儲值卡的數量上限。

en.headline: Worker dies after fall at Tung Chung construction site
en.dek: Police said a 30-year-old man fell onto a platform at a Wui Tung Street site on Wednesday afternoon and was later certified dead at North Lantau Hospital.

zh.headline: 東涌匯東街地盤工人高處墮下 送院後不治
zh.dek: 警方稱一名30歲男工周三下午在匯東街地盤墮下至平台，送北大嶼山醫院搶救，約下午2時半證實死亡。

en.headline: Transport Department sets Huanggang bus and taxi plans
en.dek: The rebuilt crossing will run around the clock, with seven franchised bus routes, a public-transport buffer and a ticket system for taxis.

zh.headline: 運輸署交代新皇崗口岸巴士及的士安排
zh.dek: 重建口岸將24小時運作，設7條專營巴士線及公交緩衝區。空載的士須先取籌，後備巴士約兩分鐘可到上客區。

en.headline: Hui says talks continue on London gold delivery standards
en.dek: The treasury secretary told a Sorrento conference that an Asian forum with the London association is set for Hong Kong next April.

zh.headline: 許正宇：正與倫敦金銀市場協會談合格交割標準
zh.dek: 財庫局局長在意大利索倫托表示，若合作落實，有助把國際認可標準融入本港黃金市場基建。亞洲論壇訂明年4月在港合辦。

en.headline: Police hold four over alleged 70 million dollar mortgage fraud
en.dek: Commercial crime officers said three men and a woman were arrested on Tuesday over fake payroll records used to obtain loans on one flat.

zh.headline: 商罪科拘4人 涉以假出糧紀錄騙取逾7000萬元按揭
zh.dek: 警方稱周二拘捕3男1女，涉嫌為一個住宅物業向三間金融機構申請按揭，並以空殼公司製造虛假出糧紀錄。

en.headline: Hang Seng slips 128 points at the Wednesday midday close
en.dek: After two rising sessions the index closed the morning at 24,151, down 0.5 per cent, with the technology gauge back under 4,200.

zh.headline: 恒指半日收市跌128點 科技指數失守4200點
zh.dek: 港股連升兩日後回吐，中午報24151點，跌0.5%。科技指數半日報4184點，跌0.9%。

en.headline: Surveyor lifts Stanley and Shek Mun site values after Ho Man Tin tender
en.dek: Vigers raised its Stanley plot estimate by as much as about 42 per cent after Kerry's bid came in well above earlier forecasts.

zh.headline: 測量師上調赤柱及石門地皮估值 何文田投標後
zh.dek: 嘉里以逾43.08億元投得佛光街住宅地後，華坊把環角道地皮估值上調最多約四成二。

en.headline: Lo says public healthcare subsidy remains at 95 per cent
en.dek: The health secretary told lawmakers fee waivers have widened sharply, while accident and emergency visits in the first nine months edged down.

zh.headline: 盧寵茂：收費改革後公營醫療資助仍維持95%
zh.dek: 醫務衞生局局長回覆立法會，指費用減免覆蓋擴大，首九個月急症室求診人次按年微跌。

en.headline: Police investigate report of child carrying beer in Tuen Mun
en.dek: Officers said they received a report on Tuesday night at Fu Tai Estate. No arrest had been made, and the girl's school said it had offered help.

zh.headline: 警方調查屯門女童被安排搬運啤酒
zh.dek: 警方稱周二晚接獲富泰邨報案，暫未有人被捕。女童就讀的學校表示已提供協助及輔導。

en.headline: Chan opens three-day LegCo debate on the five-year plan
en.dek: The Chief Secretary moved the motion on the 2026-2030 plan and said success depends on putting it into practice, with the Policy Address as the yearly programme.

zh.headline: 陳國基動議五年規劃議案 立法會展開三日合併辯論
zh.dek: 政務司司長周三動議2026至2030年經濟和社會發展第一個五年規劃議案，並指規劃落到實處才是成功關鍵。

en.headline: M+ fantasy exhibition opens in the West Gallery on 17 October
en.dek: Myths and Monsters runs until 4 April 2027 on level two, tracing fantasy in Asian visual culture from the nineteenth century to the present.

zh.headline: M+西展廳10月17日展開「神話與怪獸」展覽
zh.dek: 「神話與怪獸：亞洲的奇幻異境」展至2027年4月4日，在西九M+二樓西展廳舉行，梳理十九至二十一世紀亞洲視覺文化中的幻想。

en.headline: School bus hits a kerb in Tai Po, children taken to hospital
en.dek: A driver reported the crash on On Po Road at 8.27am. Ambulance crews classed two children as semi-urgent and seven as minor.

zh.headline: 大埔安埔路校巴撞石壆 學童清醒送院
zh.dek: 司機上午8時27分報案，指安埔路12號對開失事。救護分流兩名學童屬黃色、七名屬綠色，全部清醒送往大埔那打素醫院。

en.headline: Tin Hau entrance stall sells for 280,000 dollars at fair auction
en.dek: Bidding for the 2027 Victoria Park Lunar New Year fair opened on Wednesday. The new top fast-food pitch went for 280,000 dollars.

zh.headline: 維園年宵天后入口快餐檔以28萬元成交
zh.dek: 2027年維園年宵攤位周三起在荔枝角政府合署公開競投。近天后興發街入口的A檔以28萬元成交，底價為120,470元。

en.headline: Unions name labour slates as Election Committee nominations open
en.dek: The Federation of Trade Unions is fielding 46 candidates and the Federation of Labour Unions 12 for the 60 elected labour seats.

zh.headline: 工聯會派46人、勞聯派12人參選選委會勞工界
zh.dek: 選委會界別分組選舉提名期周三開始。工聯會名單包括去年立法會選舉未能連任的郭偉強及陸頌雄。

en.headline: Victoria Park lantern display lights up for a final night
en.dek: The Tourism Board's International Mid-Autumn Lantern Spectacular, extended through the National Day holiday, ends on Wednesday, with lights from 6.30pm to 11pm.

zh.headline: 維園國際中秋綵燈匯今晚最後一夜亮燈
zh.dek: 旅發局展覽延長至周三，涵蓋國慶假期，亮燈時間為下午6時半至晚上11時。康文署維園中秋綵燈會展期同樣延至今日。

en.headline: Housing Department says On Pak Court repairs are past 80 per cent
en.dek: The Anderson Road Home Ownership Scheme estate, the department's first modular project, is aiming to finish expanded paint work by mid-October.

zh.headline: 房署指安柏苑外牆修繕已完成逾八成
zh.dek: 觀塘安達臣道居屋安柏苑是房屋署首個組裝合成居屋項目，署方稱承建商正爭取10月中旬前完成已擴大範圍的油漆修繕。

en.headline: Observatory issues red fire danger warning
en.dek: The warning, raised at 7.45am, means the fire risk is extreme. At 8am the Observatory recorded 24 degrees and humidity of 55 per cent.

zh.headline: 天文台發出紅色火災危險警告 火險極高
zh.dek: 警告於周三上午7時45分發出並持續生效，表示火災危險性極高。上午8時天文台錄得24度，相對濕度55%。

en.headline: School nomination scheme for university places opens today
en.dek: The Education Bureau scheme runs until 2 December. Each local secondary school may nominate two students for one of more than 300 funded programmes.

zh.headline: 學校推薦直接錄取計劃今起接受提名
zh.dek: 教育局第六屆計劃提名期至12月2日。每間本地中學可推薦最多兩名中六生，報讀逾300個教資會資助課程之一。

en.headline: Cyclist taken to hospital after taxi crash on Boundary Street
en.dek: A man riding a road bicycle was conscious when ambulance crews took him to Caritas Medical Centre after a collision with a taxi.

zh.headline: 界限街的士與公路單車相撞 單車男清醒送院
zh.dek: 凌晨一輛的士在西洋菜北街與界限街交界撞倒單車，騎手清醒，由救護車送往明愛醫院。

en.headline: Police seize drugs worth 1.42 million dollars in Cheung Sha Wan
en.dek: West Kowloon detectives searched a subdivided flat after stopping a woman outside and found suspected cocaine, methamphetamine and packaging tools.

zh.headline: 警方在長沙灣劏房檢獲市值約142萬元毒品
zh.dek: 西九龍重案組周一晚在長沙灣截查一名女子後搜查其租住劏房，檢獲懷疑可卡因、冰毒及包裝工具。

en.headline: Fraser Institute again ranks Hong Kong the freest economy
en.dek: The 2026 report, based on 2024 data, keeps the city first among 165 jurisdictions, while the government cites trade freedom and regulation.

zh.headline: 菲沙研究所再評香港為全球最自由經濟體
zh.dek: 2026年度報告以2024年數據把香港列165個司法管轄區之首，政府指貿易自由維持首位、規管列第二。

en.headline: Happy Valley opens a three-week Oktoberfest on race night
en.dek: The Jockey Club says tonight's Happy Wednesday meeting starts an Oktoberfest programme, with a ceremony at 6pm led by the German consul.

zh.headline: 跑馬地周三賽事揭幕德國啤酒節 一連三周
zh.dek: 馬會表示今晚Happy Wednesday以德國啤酒節揭幕，下午6時由德國總領事及馬會行政總裁主持開幕禮。

en.headline: Woman, 47, dies after collapsing at Tai Tong village house
en.dek: A woman was found collapsed at a village house on Kiu Hing Road in the early hours and was later certified dead at Pok Oi Hospital.

zh.headline: 元朗大棠村47歲女子住所暈倒 送院後不治
zh.dek: 警方接報指一名女子凌晨在僑興路村屋暈倒，送往博愛醫院後證實死亡，死因有待驗屍確定。

en.headline: Officers confirm Tsim Sha Tsui powder letter contained flour
en.dek: Explosives officers examined a letter opened at a Humphreys Avenue commercial building and said the white powder was flour.

zh.headline: 爆炸品處理課證實尖沙咀粉末信內是麵粉
zh.dek: 堪富利士道商廈保安拆信發現白色粉末及恐嚇字句，爆炸品處理課檢驗後證實是麵粉，案件列刑事恐嚇。

en.headline: Happiness index slips to 5.87, below pass mark for fourth year
en.dek: A Wofoo survey of 1,039 adults put the city at 5.87 out of 10, with Generation Y the least happy age group and more than 40 per cent reporting depressive symptoms.

zh.headline: 本港開心指數降至5.87 連續第四年未達合格線
zh.dek: 和富社會企業「香港開心D」訪問1039名成人，指數由去年5.95跌至5.87；約30至45歲組別最低，逾四成受訪者呈中度至嚴重抑鬱症狀。

en.headline: Tai Po estate block loses water and lifts after pipe leak
en.dek: More than 670 households at Kwong Chi House in Kwong Fuk Estate were without running water and lift service after a leak in the underground pump room.

zh.headline: 大埔廣福邨廣智樓喉管漏水 逾670戶停水停𨋢
zh.dek: 廣智樓地下水喉房喉管漏水，大廈緊急停水並暫停升降機，區議員引述管理公司指部分食水料凌晨恢復，𨋢最快周三修復。

en.headline: Free harbourfront shows continue as arts expo opens Friday
en.dek: The Hong Kong Performing Arts Expo runs from 9 to 13 October, with free outdoor performances at the Cultural Centre plaza each afternoon through Friday.

zh.headline: 演藝博覽周五開幕 文化中心露天廣場免費演出至周五
zh.dek: 第二屆香港演藝博覽10月9日至13日舉行，序幕節目由周二起至周五每日下午4時半至7時半在文化中心露天廣場免費演出。

en.headline: Food safety centre orders recall of mislabelled bamboo shoots
en.dek: A prepackaged sample sold through HKTV Mall contained sulphur dioxide within the legal limit, but the label did not name the additive.

zh.headline: 食安中心令預先包裝竹筍停售回收 標籤未列二氧化硫
zh.dek: 樣本經HKTV Mall出售，檢出的二氧化硫未超出法定上限，但標籤沒有標明添加劑名稱及作用類別。

en.headline: Tourism Board extends Halloween night bus and tram rides to six days
en.dek: Costumed riders who spend at partner outlets can collect free night rides on selected weekends from 17 October through Halloween.

zh.headline: 旅發局擴大萬聖月夜間巴士及電車 增至六天
zh.dek: 盛裝人士在合作商戶消費達指定金額，可於10月17日起指定周末換領免費夜間乘車體驗，涵蓋萬聖節當日。

en.headline: Education Bureau clears fee rises at private and DSS schools
en.dek: Average approved increases for this academic year are 4.75 per cent at private schools, 4.07 per cent at Direct Subsidy Scheme schools and 4 per cent at international schools.

zh.headline: 教育局批准私校及直資校加學費 平均加幅介乎4%至4.75%
zh.dek: 本學年私校、直資學校及國際學校獲批的平均學費加幅，分別為4.75%、4.07%及4%。

en.headline: Hong Kong Youth Olympics team receives its flag
en.dek: Fifteen athletes will contest 12 sports in Dakar from 31 October to 13 November, the first Olympic event hosted in Africa.

zh.headline: 達卡青奧會港隊代表團今日授旗
zh.dek: 港隊派15人出戰12個項目，賽事10月31日至11月13日在塞內加爾達卡舉行，為非洲首次主辦的奧林匹克賽事。

en.headline: Election Committee nomination opens on Wednesday
en.dek: The Electoral Affairs Commission chairman said preparations are ready as the subsector nomination period runs from 7 to 20 October.

zh.headline: 選委會界別分組選舉提名期周三展開
zh.dek: 選管會主席陸啟康視察添馬選舉主任辦事處，稱提名期安排已準備就緒；提名由周三起至10月20日。

en.headline: Most Po Pin Chau visitors say booking eased crowds
en.dek: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department said about 1,160 people visited the section on Tuesday under the trial booking system.

zh.headline: 破邊洲大部分遊人稱預約後體驗更好
zh.dek: 漁護署表示周二約1160人到訪東壩破邊洲段，問卷中大部分遊人稱預約制有效控制人流，觀景台較以前暢順。

en.headline: Four elderly-home residents carrying resistant bacteria
en.dek: The Centre for Health Protection is investigating a cluster at a Southern District care home after hospital screening found four residents carrying the bacteria.

zh.headline: 南區安老院四名院友帶有抗藥性腸道桿菌
zh.dek: 衞生防護中心正調查南區一間安老院的帶菌群組，四名同層院友入院篩查證實帶有產碳青霉烯酶腸道桿菌，暫無相關病徵。

en.headline: Tung Chung Line to close early on 28 November
en.dek: Trains between Tung Chung and Sunny Bay will end around 11pm that night for a key turnout installation on the extension.

zh.headline: 東涌綫11月28日晚上提早收車
zh.dek: 港鐵稱當晚東涌至欣澳列車約晚上11時結束，以配合延綫第三次關鍵道岔安裝，並設免費接駁巴士。

en.headline: High Court jails man for life over Kowloon Bay killing
en.dek: A jury found Tam Yun-chiu guilty of murdering bus driver Ho Lok-man after a dispute at Amoy Gardens in September 2023.

zh.headline: 淘大花園命案裝修工謀殺罪成 判囚終身
zh.dek: 高等法院陪審團裁定52歲譚潤超謀殺巴士司機何洛文罪名成立，案件源於2023年9月淘大花園一宗吸煙爭執。

en.headline: Man found dead in Cheung Sha Wan flat, woman taken to hospital
en.dek: Police said security staff at One Madison on Castle Peak Road reported an unusual smell at about 5:20pm, and firefighters forced entry.

zh.headline: 長沙灣單位老翁證實死亡 七旬女子送明愛
zh.dek: 警方稱青山道305號One Madison保安下午約5時20分報案，指單位傳出異味且住戶多時未露面，消防其後破門。

en.headline: HKMA and Malaysia's central bank widen fraud and market ties
en.dek: The authorities said they would set up a policy group on compliant cross-border stablecoin uses and strengthen links between payment systems.

zh.headline: 金管局與馬來西亞央行加強打擊騙案及市場聯通
zh.dek: 雙方宣布成立政策工作小組，推動合規跨境穩定幣應用，並加強即時支付結算系統之間的聯通。

en.headline: Mong Kok rooftop fire put out, no injuries reported
en.dek: The blaze at Shun King Building on Nelson Street was extinguished at about 6:42pm after 30 to 40 residents left the building.

zh.headline: 旺角順景大廈天台火警救熄 暫無傷亡報告
zh.dek: 奶路臣街順景大廈天台火警於傍晚約6時42分救熄，約30至40名住戶自行走到地面，警方稱暫無人受傷。

en.headline: Police warn of fake site offering ticket-fine discounts
en.dek: The force said a fraudulent site posing as the electronic traffic ticket platform seeks card and personal data, and that fines carry no early-payment discount.

zh.headline: 警方揭偽冒電子告票網站 稱早交罰款有折扣
zh.dek: 警務處說該網站誘使市民提供信用卡及個人資料，強調繳交告票罰款不設任何折扣，電子告票短訊亦不會附超連結。

en.headline: Kerry wins Ho Man Tin site for over 4.3 billion dollars
en.dek: The Lands Department said Kerry Properties took the Fat Kwong Street residential lot, at more than 20,738 dollars per square foot of floor area, well above market forecasts.

zh.headline: 嘉里逾43.08億投得何文田佛光街住宅地
zh.dek: 地政總署公布作價遠高於市場預期上限，每平方呎樓面地價逾20738元，上周五截標共收10份標書。

en.headline: Firefighters tackle rooftop blaze at Mong Kok building
en.dek: Police said multiple callers reported the fire at Shun King Building on Nelson Street around 5:30pm, with dozens evacuated and no injuries reported.

zh.headline: 旺角順景大廈天台火警 數十人疏散暫無受傷報告
zh.dek: 警方稱下午約5時半接獲多人報案，指奶路臣街順景大廈天台起火，初步消息指雜物燒着，消防以一喉及煙帽隊灌救。

en.headline: Two public-housing tenants jailed over undeclared flats
en.dek: The Housing Department said tenants in Choi Hung and Kwong Tin estates were convicted after failing to declare homes they owned when filing income and asset forms in 2025.

zh.headline: 兩公屋住戶虛報無物業 被判監禁
zh.dek: 房屋署說彩虹邨及廣田邨兩宗個案的住戶，2025年填報入息及資產時沒有申報本港物業，罪名成立後被判監。

en.headline: Securities industry posts 51.7 billion dollar half-year profit
en.dek: The SFC said net profit rose 21 percent from the previous half, while brokers' trading across stocks, bonds and other securities hit a record 149 trillion dollars.

zh.headline: 證券業上半年淨盈利517億元 經紀交易額創新高
zh.dek: 證監會報告指淨盈利較去年下半年升21%，經紀行股票、債券及其他證券交易總額達149萬億元，活躍客戶約570萬。

en.headline: CBRE says Grade A office rents rise for a fourth quarter
en.dek: The consultancy put the third-quarter gain at 3.2 percent and the vacancy rate at 15.5 percent at the end of September.

zh.headline: 世邦魏理仕：甲廈租金連升四季
zh.dek: 報告指第三季甲級寫字樓租金按季升3.2%，9月底空置率降至15.5%。

en.headline: Hang Seng closes 240 points higher, up 1 percent
en.dek: The index finished Tuesday at 24,280 after an early jump faded, with drug shares leading and turnover near 98.3 billion dollars.

zh.headline: 恆指收市升240點 全日升約1%
zh.dek: 港股星期二收報24280點，初段升幅其後收窄，醫藥股領漲，主板成交近983億元。

en.headline: Eligible residents can register for Huanggang joint e-channels
en.dek: The Immigration Department said Hong Kong residents can enrol from Tuesday for the rebuilt crossing's cooperative-inspection lanes.

zh.headline: 合資格居民即日起可登記皇崗合作查驗通道
zh.dek: 入境處表示，重建後的皇崗口岸稍後開通，合資格香港居民可由星期二起經香港e-道程式登記。

en.headline: Housing Bureau reminds Wang Fuk owners of 15 October deadline
en.dek: Owners in blocks A to H who accepted the buyout must sign sale agreements by 15 October, with discretion for special cases.

zh.headline: 房屋局提醒宏福苑業主本月15日前簽協議
zh.dek: A至H座已交回接受收購信件的業主，須於10月15日或之前簽出售單位協議，特殊情況可獲酌情。

en.headline: West Kowloon deficit widens to 998 million dollars
en.dek: The Authority said the 2025/26 operating shortfall grew by about 229 million dollars, mainly on preparations for the performing-arts centre.

zh.headline: 西九管理局赤字擴大至9.98億元
zh.dek: 管理局稱2025/26年度赤字較上一財年多約2.29億元，主因是西九演藝中心開幕前的前期準備。

en.headline: Swedish food museum stays at Kai Tak Airside until late November
en.dek: The Disgusting Food Museum, on its first Hong Kong run, is at GATE33 in Airside through 26 November, with weekday and weekend hours published by the organisers.

zh.headline: 瑞典「嘔心食物」展暫駐啟德AIRSIDE至11月底
zh.dek: 源自瑞典馬爾默的「嘔心食物博物館」首度來港，在啟德AIRSIDE三樓GATE33展出至11月26日，平日與周末開放時間不同。

en.headline: Nine named Outstanding Young Persons, including fencer and jockey
en.dek: The 2026 selection was announced at the Convention and Exhibition Centre, with foil fencer Choi Chun-yin and jockey Vincent Ho among the nine recipients.

zh.headline: 十大傑青揭曉 劍擊蔡俊彥及騎師何澤堯在列
zh.dek: 2026年十大傑出青年選舉周二在灣仔會展公布，九人獲選，包括剛完成名古屋亞運的劍擊選手蔡俊彥及騎師何澤堯。

en.headline: Sun says Sandy Ridge computing power to reach 36 times today's level
en.dek: The innovation secretary told legislators the first five-year plan treats artificial intelligence as a core industry, with a Sandy Ridge data campus due by 2032.

zh.headline: 孫東：沙嶺數據園區2032年前算力料達現時36倍
zh.dek: 創新科技及工業局局長孫東向立法會簡介五年規劃，指人工智能是重點產業，沙嶺數據園區已動工，累計投資最少238億元。

en.headline: Hang Seng adds 188 points at the Tuesday midday close
en.dek: The index finished the morning at 24,228 after touching 24,354, with turnover above HK$54 billion and the tech index up nearly 0.9 percent.

zh.headline: 恒指半日升188點 報24228點
zh.dek: 指數曾高見24354點，其後升幅收窄，半日主板成交逾540億元，科指升近0.9%。

en.headline: Labour Department bars firm from imported-worker applications for two years
en.dek: The department said the firm added hiring conditions without consent and refused qualified local applicants for clerk and painting-worker posts.

zh.headline: 勞工處制裁浩展太平洋 兩年內不受理輸入勞工申請
zh.dek: 處方說該公司申請輸入普通文員及髹漆工時，未經同意新增招聘條件，並無合理理由拒絕合資格求職者。

en.headline: Hong Kong Ballet returns to Tai Kwun swan show this weekend
en.dek: Tai Kwun lists adapted House of Swans performances on Saturday and Sunday afternoon, with exhibition tickets at HK$50 and entry limited by gallery capacity.

zh.headline: 大館《House of Swans》周末再有香港芭蕾舞團演出
zh.dek: 大館公布10月10及11日下午2時半至3時15分有改編演出，展覽門票50元，場內人數有限，先到先得。

en.headline: Police examine powder letter at Tsim Sha Tsui office building
en.dek: Officers closed a stretch of Humphreys Avenue after a security guard reported a letter containing white powder at 3 Humphreys Avenue around 9:28am.

zh.headline: 尖沙咀商廈信箱現白色粉末信 爆炸品處理課到場
zh.dek: 早上9時28分保安員報案，堪富利士道3號時財商業大廈地下信箱有可疑信件，警方封鎖一段道路調查。

en.headline: Lee says nurse demand persists and local hires come first
en.dek: The Chief Executive said 99.8 percent of Hospital Authority nurses were locally trained, and that more than 3,000 posts were still vacant.

zh.headline: 李家超：護士需求長期存在 招聘以本地人才優先
zh.dek: 特首說醫管局現職護士99.8%為本地培訓，目前仍有逾3000個護士空缺可供畢業生申請。

en.headline: Lee says One Stanley steel-bar case is under investigation
en.dek: The Chief Executive said the Buildings Department is examining whether main bars match the approved drawings, and asked the Development Bureau to oversee the probe.

zh.headline: 李家超：屋宇署正調查赤柱ONE STANLEY鋼筋問題
zh.dek: 特首說屋宇署正查主鋼筋數量是否與圖則相符，並已要求發展局監督調查，違規會依法嚴懲。

en.headline: September PMI slips to 49.2 as hiring falls again
en.dek: S&P Global said the seasonally adjusted reading was down from 49.5 in August, a second month below 50, with the sharpest job cuts in nearly six and a half years.

zh.headline: 香港9月PMI降至49.2 就業收縮近六年半最快
zh.dek: 標普全球公布經季節調整指數由8月49.5跌至49.2，連續兩個月低於50，職位收縮速度創近六年半新高。

en.headline: Man found dead in the water off Tai Po Waterfront Park
en.dek: Police said a man in his twenties was recovered near Tai Po Waterfront Park around 7:30am on Tuesday and was confirmed dead. Identity and circumstances are under investigation.

zh.headline: 大埔海濱公園對開海面發現男子 證實死亡
zh.dek: 警方說星期二約早上7時半接報，大埔海濱公園對開有人在海中，救起一名20多歲男子後證實不治，身份及經過仍在調查。

en.headline: Lee says Wang Fuk reforms will follow the inquiry report
en.dek: The Chief Executive said the government would study the independent committee's recommendations as soon as they arrive, then set out reforms and pursue accountability.

zh.headline: 李家超：宏福苑報告交到後會盡快改革並追究責任
zh.dek: 特首說獨立委員會提交報告後，政府會即時研究建議、推行改革並公布細節，同時追究責任。

en.headline: Observatory records 23.3 degrees, autumn's coolest morning
en.dek: The Observatory said 23.3 degrees by 7:30am was the lowest since autumn began, with a high near 29 degrees expected later.

zh.headline: 天文台今早錄得23.3度 入秋以來最低
zh.dek: 天文台說截至早上7時半最低23.3度，是今年入秋以來最低，日間最高氣溫約29度。

en.headline: Cyclothon returns to West Kowloon this Sunday
en.dek: The Tourism Board lists a 56km ride from 5:15am and a UCI Class 1.1 race later on 11 October, both based at the cultural district.

zh.headline: 香港單車節周日在西九文化區舉行
zh.dek: 旅發局公布11日有56公里騎行，清晨5時15分開騎，同日亦有UCI 1.1級公路賽，起終點在西九。

en.headline: Science Park carnival opens activity sign-up this morning
en.dek: The Innovation and Technology Commission says free workshop and talk places for the late-October carnival can be booked from 10:30am.

zh.headline: 創新科技嘉年華今早開放部分活動報名
zh.dek: 創新科技署主辦的科學園嘉年華於10月24日起舉行，工作坊及網上講座今早10時半起可網上報名，入場免費。

en.headline: Four vehicles collide on Tuen Mun Highway near Tai Lam
en.dek: Police said three people were slightly hurt and remained conscious after two taxis and two private cars collided late on Monday night.

zh.headline: 屯門公路近大欖四車相撞 三人輕傷
zh.dek: 警方稱周一晚接報，屯門公路往屯門方向近大欖有兩輛的士及兩輛私家車相撞，三人受輕傷並保持清醒。

en.headline: Police hold 19 after West Kowloon illegal-work operation
en.dek: Officers said Monday's joint sweep of restaurants, massage shops and buildings led to 19 arrests, including two wanted men.

zh.headline: 西九龍反黑工行動拘19人 包括兩名通緝男子
zh.dek: 警方稱周一聯同相關部門突擊搜查食肆、按摩店及大廈，拘捕19人，其中兩名男子是通緝人士。

en.headline: West Kowloon police ticket four taxi drivers in checks
en.dek: Officers said Monday's operation produced four summonses, covering refused hires, extra phones and missing displays.

zh.headline: 西九龍打擊的士違例 四名司機被發傳票
zh.dek: 警方稱周一行動發出四張傳票，涉拒載、駕駛時放置多於兩部手機，以及未展示計程錶和司機證。

en.headline: North Point owners' corporation fined over worker's fall
en.dek: Eastern Magistrates' Courts fined the Kingsfield Garden corporation HK$149,000 after a tree worker fell from a car-park wall last July and later died.

zh.headline: 北角業主立案法團因修剪工人墮下被罰14.9萬
zh.dek: 東區裁判法院星期一裁定京士花園法團違反職安條例，罰款14.9萬元。工人去年七月在停車場矮牆墮下，兩星期後不治。

en.headline: Gelato market returns to PMQ from Friday to Sunday
en.dek: Ciao Gelato Fest lists a second weekend at PMQ on Aberdeen Street, with free entry, 20 stalls and a HK$188 pass for six mini cups.

zh.headline: 意式雪糕市集周五至日再在元創方舉行
zh.dek: Ciao Gelato Fest 公布第二個周末回到鴨巴甸街元創方，入場免費，約20個品牌設檔，188元套票可換六杯迷你雪糕。

en.headline: Customs and police raid 23 Sham Shui Po cigarette spots
en.dek: A joint operation from 18 to 30 September seized about 100,000 illicit cigarettes worth an estimated HK$480,000 and led to five arrests.

zh.headline: 海關聯同深水埗警區搗破23個私煙據點
zh.dek: 9月18日至30日的聯合行動檢獲約10萬支私煙，估計市值48萬元，拘捕五人，包括四名本地人士及一名越南籍男子。

en.headline: Bureau names eight firms as industrial elite enterprises
en.dek: The Innovation, Technology and Industry Bureau said the inaugural list follows more than 100 nominations, with an award ceremony expected before the end of the year.

zh.headline: 創科局公布首屆八家新型工業菁英企業
zh.dek: 創新科技及工業局說，計劃接獲逾100項提名，評審看科研、成長和本地貢獻，頒獎禮預計今年內舉行。

en.headline: RTHK launches new media platform and mascot
en.dek: The broadcaster said the platform and an AI-generated mascot follow a Policy Address pledge, and that schools may use a new education corner free of charge.

zh.headline: 港台推出新媒體平台和吉祥物「電電」
zh.dek: 港台說平台和人工智能吉祥物落實施政報告的相關表述，並向學校免費授權十多套教育及青年節目作教學播放。

en.headline: Aviation department follows up fireworks drone footage
en.dek: The Civil Aviation Department said it is handling a case under its usual procedures after footage appeared to show a drone over Victoria Harbour on National Day.

zh.headline: 民航處跟進疑在維港拍國慶煙花的無人機片段
zh.dek: 民航處說正按既定程序跟進個案，並重申在限制飛行區操作小型無人機屬進階操作，須事先獲許可。

en.headline: About 1,200 visited Po Pin Chau section on Monday
en.dek: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department said bookings for Tuesday are full, while Sai Kung East campsites logged about 130 tents overnight with no breaches found.

zh.headline: 漁護署：星期一約1200人到訪破邊洲段
zh.dek: 署方說星期二預約已額滿，星期三仍有名額；西貢東三個營地昨晚約有130個帳篷，未發現違規。

en.headline: Food safety centre orders stop-sale of chilled shrimp batch
en.dek: A pre-packaged sample from a North Point shop contained a trace of a banned veterinary-drug metabolite, and the distributor has started a recall.

zh.headline: 食安中心指令停售一批去腸白蝦仁
zh.dek: 北角一新鮮糧食店的預先包裝冷藏蝦肉驗出微量禁用獸藥代謝物，分銷商已按指示回收受影響批次。

en.headline: HKMA signs pact to link regional trade data
en.dek: A pilot linking Hong Kong's commercial data platform with a Shanghai digital-trade system has produced 10 loan approvals worth HK$180 million, the authority said.

zh.headline: 金管局與數位貿易聯盟簽備忘錄 接通貿易數據
zh.dek: 金管局說，商業數據通與上海數字貿易平台的試點已促成10宗貿易融資批核，貸款額達1.8億元。

en.headline: Government warns against fake Huanggang all-day quota claims
en.dek: Vehicles with permits for three designated ports may use Lok Ma Chau or the new Huanggang Port only between midnight and 6:30am, and the case has been referred to law enforcement.

zh.headline: 政府籲勿信皇崗口岸可全日過關的虛假信息
zh.dek: 持指定口岸許可證的粵港常規配額車輛，只可於凌晨至早上6時30分經落馬洲或新皇崗往來，事件已轉交執法部門。

en.headline: Boy, 10, in serious condition with flu and shock
en.dek: The Centre for Health Protection said the child tested positive for influenza A and remains in intensive care, taking serious paediatric cases since late June to 22.

zh.headline: 十歲男童染甲流併發休克 情況嚴重
zh.dek: 衞生防護中心說，男童對甲型流感呈陽性，仍在兒童深切治療部留醫，6月底至今兒童嚴重個案累計22宗。

en.headline: Manpower panel flags rise in youth unemployment
en.dek: Seasonally adjusted unemployment edged up to 3.8 percent in June to August, and officials briefed the panel on a 30,000-place youth jobs scheme.

zh.headline: 人力規劃委員會關注青年失業 失業率升至3.8%
zh.dek: 經季節性調整的失業率由5至7月的3.7%升至6至8月的3.8%，官員向委員會簡介三萬個青年職位及實習計劃。
